title: Change FtueStep to hold string-resource IDs instead of resolved strings
description: FtueStep's fields hold resource IDs now (plain Int constants), not resolved text, since the top-level ftueSteps list is not itself a @Composable context and can't call stringResource() directly.
acceptance_criteria: FtueStep's fields are renamed/retyped to titleRes: Int and bodyRes: Int
No other part of the data class changes
exact_code:
val titleRes: Int,
    val bodyRes: Int
